title: The TileSetAtlasSource atlas has no tile at (21,0)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.5.1

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100)

### Issue description

When initially creating a TileMapLayer and not setting the Tile Size to begin with, and change it later, you end up with many errors that say:

```create_tile: Cannot create tile. The tile is outside the texture or tiles are already present in the space the tile would cover.
has_alternative_tile: The TileSetAtlasSource atlas has no tile at (20,0).
create_alternative_tile: TileSetAtlasSource has no tile at (20,0).```

There is no apparent way to fix this or to know which tiles are causing the issue.



### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new TileMapLayer
2. Select TileSet from the Tile Set property
3. Click on TileSet tab at the bottom of Godot
4. Drag your spritesheet into the Tile Sources panel
5. Click on "Yes" to add the tiles to the atlas
6. Set the Tile Set properties to the correct size (say from 16px to 64px)
7. Set the TileSet Atlas Texture Region Size to the correct size (say from 16px to 64px)
8. Run your project
9. The errors show up under Debugger

There is no clear way on how to fix this. Currently I have to determine which TileSet is causing the problem, deleting it, and recreating it again. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No MRP at this time.
